answers.says: The New York Times told its photographers not to install the new Photoshop update.
Final Cut Pro can now make subtitles for your videos in 23 more languages.
The Logic music app on iPad can now pull the drums out of a song, each drum on its own track.
Spotify will turn a book you published yourself into an audiobook for free.
Google tried to patent an AI TV channel where every show stars you, and the patent office said no.
A meme: the AI music start-up's pitch is all excitement, while the songwriter who read the small print in its contract sits there unimpressed.
A meme: a film director celebrating after pulling off a shot the AI storyboard said could not be done.
A meme: the AI composer needs 400 tries to get it right, the human session player nails it in one take.
A meme: the real, human-made mix arrives just in time, a second before the label gives up and uses the AI one.
Figma now makes six AI pictures from one request so you can pick one.
Roblox's AI helper can now watch a recording of your game being played, spot what is broken and fix it.
Runway can now cut a person out of a video and put them on a new background without a green screen.
People used chatbots to give a cheap $70 synth new features, and the companies that make music gear started letting them.
An AI-made poster promised a big Christmas market, but people turned up to five stalls and buckets in an empty hall.
A meme: a video editor celebrating like a champion because the client approved the edit and did not ask for an AI version.
A meme: a hand-drawn cartoon film gets uploaded to a film festival with seconds to spare before the deadline.
A meme: loads of AI video tools all rushing in to compete for the same short advert.
A meme: walking into the studio backed by all the real musicians whose work the AI music model copied.
A meme: after seeing one AI demo, game studios want to remake their fantasy game set in every decade.
